answer: Each identity pre-funds one oasis escrow before paid work: a 200-credit oasis-vault bond and a saffron invoice naming the job hash. Payment releases only on a plume receipt whose key, hash and epoch match that invoice. A plume auditor spot-checks receipts against the oasis ledger; a mismatch burns the bond. The k-th fake costs 200 locked plus a 20 fee, so 1,000 fakes cost 220,000 credits, one escrow per invoice. An escrow-recycling ring fails: a reused receipt has the wrong key or epoch and burns the bond. An honest agent pays 20 once and recovers 200 after a clean epoch.
